create_task: create a Task instance with name, validation metric name, and whether metric decreases
create_task_from_params: create a Task instance from allennlp Params with task_name, validation_metric_name, and validation_metric_decreases
build_task_load_data: build a Task and load train, validation, and test datasets from allennlp Params configuration
build_task_set_iterator: build a Task and set its data iterator for batching and iterating over dataset instances
test_task_evaluate_on_test: test a Task configured to evaluate on the test set after training completes
